```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
fixed_air_travel <- air_travel
fixed_air_travel_delay <- air_travel$ArrDelay
# Assume cancelled flight has 0 delay
fixed_air_travel_delay[is.na(fixed_air_travel_delay)] <- 0 
fixed_air_travel$ArrDelay <- fixed_air_travel_delay

X <- fixed_air_travel %>% mutate(TotalTime = CRSElapsedTime + ArrDelay) %>% select(Origin, Dest, TotalTime)

```

```{r}
X_small <- X[1:1000,]

X_symmetric <- bind_rows(
  X_small,
  X_small %>% transmute(
    Origin = Dest,
    Dest = Origin,
    TotalTime = TotalTime
  )
)

X_symmetric

all_locations <- sort(unique(c(X_symmetric$Origin, X_symmetric$Dest)))
length(all_locations)
length(unique(X_symmetric$Origin))
length(unique(X_symmetric$Dest))

# Convert from long format to wide format
wide_X <- X_symmetric %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dest,
    values_from = TotalTime,
    values_fn = mean,
  )

D <- as.matrix(wide_X[, -1])
rownames(D) <- sort(wide_X$Origin)

missing_cols <- setdiff(all_locations, colnames(D))

D <- cbind(
  D,
  matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(D), ncol = length(missing_cols),
         dimnames = list(NULL, missing_cols))
)

# Reorder columns to match rows
D <- D[, all_locations, drop = FALSE]

diag(D) <- 0

```
